next.reason: §1985:VII.4.3.2 opens sequential files INPUT with an optional REVERSED or WITH NO REWIND per file, OUTPUT with an optional WITH NO REWIND, and I-O and EXTEND with none. §2023:14.9.27.2 keeps the four modes, the repeated mode groups and '[ WITH NO REWIND ]' per file, and §2023:14.9.27.3 SR5 ('The NO REWIND phrase may be specified only for sequential files') and SR6 ('The NO REWIND phrase may be specified only when the INPUT or OUTPUT phrase is specified') keep it where the 1985 format put it. But there is no REVERSED phrase (in 1985 obsolete, §1985:VII.4.3.3 SR1 'The REVERSED phrase can only be used with sequential files'), so OPEN INPUT f REVERSED is refused at compile time; and the sharing-phrase and retry-phrase are added. Narrower and wider: CHANGED.
